case_number: 2024 INSC 621; CIVIL APPEAL NO(S). OF 2024 (Arising out of SLP(Civil) No(s). 30976 of 2017)
summary: Service classification under Central Pay Commission; SSD Fund staff eligibility for 6th CPC benefits; voluntary contribution basis disqualifying government service; distinction between SFF personnel and SSD administrators; ACP benefits not conclusive for pension entitlement; non-applicability of CCS Pension Rules 1972 due to funding source; High Court affirmance upheld; regular pay scales insufficient for statutory status.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment affirmed; pensionary benefits denied.
